lines.en: label day21:
scene yumialley0
It’s been nearly three weeks since I was reborn here.
lines.zh: 我重生到这里，已经快三个星期了。

lines.en: Have I enjoyed my time?
lines.zh: 这段时间我过得开心吗？

lines.en: Absolutely.
lines.zh: 当然开心。

lines.en: I wouldn’t trade it for the world.
lines.zh: 给我全世界我也不换。

lines.en: But still-
lines.zh: 可是——

lines.en: Something seems off.
lines.zh: 总觉得有什么地方不对劲。

lines.en: I’m leaving[school] later than normal today on account of some ‘end of term’ paperwork I needed to file in the staff room.
lines.zh: 今天我离开[school]的时间比平时晚，因为有期末的文件要交到教员室。

lines.en: Still not fully understanding how to do my job, I wind up staying later than everyone else.
lines.zh: 由于还没完全搞明白该怎么干这份工作，我最后待得比其他人都晚。

lines.en: The halls are dead now, as I’m sure you can see.
lines.zh: 走廊现在死一般寂静，我想你也能看得出来。

lines.en: There’s no one here.
lines.zh: 这里一个人都没有。

lines.en: No one at all.
lines.zh: 一个都没有。

lines.en: {s}Not even me.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}连我也没有。{/s}

lines.en: scene whereareyou
scene yumialley0
What am I doing?...
lines.zh: 我在做什么？……

lines.en: Why am I doing it?...
lines.zh: 我为什么要做？……

lines.en: Where do I go?...
lines.zh: 我该去哪儿？……

lines.en: When will I get there?...
lines.zh: 我什么时候才能到那儿？……

lines.en: These questions spread throughout my mind like an invasive species, killing off everything but themselves in an attempt to take me over once and for all.
lines.zh: 这些问题像入侵物种一样在我脑海里蔓延，把除自己之外的一切都杀光，好一举彻底占据我。

lines.en: Fighting it just makes them mate faster- and soon enough, I can not take a single step without cracking an egg.
lines.zh: 越是抵抗，它们繁殖得越快——很快，我每走一步都会踩破一枚卵。

lines.en: I walk regardless.
lines.zh: 我照走不误。

lines.en: For if I don't, there are greater consequences than just spending the night in a place I almost spent the night in anyway.
lines.zh: 因为如果我不走，后果可远不止在一个我本来就差点过夜的地方过一夜而已。

lines.en: No. If I stay here, I risk losing myself- or whatever faint traces of {i}me{/i} this body has managed to absorb during its brief vacation in an incorrect plane.
lines.zh: 不。如果我留在这儿，我可能会失去我自己——或者说，失去这具身体在错误的位面里短暂度假期间所吸收到的、属于{i}我{/i}的那点微薄痕迹。

lines.en: Another egg cracks.
lines.zh: 又一枚卵裂开了。

lines.en: scene whereareyou
scene yumialley0
And another day ends.
lines.zh: 于是又一天结束了。

lines.en: But not before I get lost in quiet contemplation of what my goal here is.
lines.zh: 但在此之前，我先是静静地沉思起自己在这儿的目标，然后迷失其中。

lines.en: And not before I give up on that and make a new one instead.
lines.zh: 也是在放弃那个目标、另立一个新的之前。

lines.en: I want to make a mountain of sorts.
lines.zh: 我想造一座山，某种意义上的山。

lines.en: I want to stand atop a pile of used up teenagers, knowing that if I were to take a rest at the summit, the pile would move and a new peak would form.
lines.zh: 我想站在一堆被用尽的少女头顶，知道哪怕我在山顶歇一口气，这堆人也会移动，又会形成新的峰顶。

lines.en: From the top to the bottom- transference of power we {i}all{/i} can enjoy.
lines.zh: 从上到下——一场我们{i}都{/i}能享受的权力转移。

lines.en: How long until the mountain forms?
lines.zh: 还要多久，这座山才能成形？

lines.en: How long until we're all used up?
lines.zh: 还要多久，我们才会被全部用尽？

lines.en: scene whereareyou
scene yumialley0r
My feet move on their own and lead me down a path I can not normally see.
lines.zh: 我的双脚自作主张，带我走上一条平时看不见的路。

lines.en: I can't say when my body successfully managed to escape the confines of the school, but I am somehow feeling {i}more{/i} confined now that I am on the outside.
lines.zh: 我说不清自己的身体是什么时候成功逃出学校的，但奇怪的是，人到了外面，反而觉得{i}更{/i}被束缚了。

lines.en: I can see a place where the sidewalk ends- and a glowing passageway of TV static beckoning me forward.
lines.zh: 我看见人行道尽头的地方——一道由电视雪花点组成的发光通道正向我招手。

lines.en: It's like it's calling me to escape.
lines.zh: 它仿佛在呼唤我逃离。

lines.en: It's like it's trying to help me.
lines.zh: 又仿佛在试图帮我。

lines.en: And yet-
lines.zh: 然而——

lines.en: I can not find it within me to move my legs.
lines.zh: 我却怎么也挪不动双腿。

lines.en: But that's fine, for there are few doors in life that only open once.
lines.zh: 不过没关系，毕竟这世上只开一次的门并不多。

lines.en: And even if this door disappears-
lines.zh: 而就算这扇门消失了——

lines.en: I can tear down whatever wall I want and make a new one.
lines.zh: 我也能推倒任何我想推倒的墙，再造一扇新的。

lines.en: This place was built for {s}you{/s} me.
lines.zh: 这个地方是{s}为你{/s}我而建的。

lines.en: I can do whatever I want with it.
lines.zh: 我想拿它做什么都行。

lines.en: Everyone else is just furniture.
lines.zh: 其他所有人不过都是家具。

lines.en: Everyone else is a part of the pile.
lines.zh: 其他所有人都是那堆东西的一部分。

lines.en: : Hey...
: What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: A voice calls out to me from a nearby alleyway.
lines.zh: 一个声音从附近的小巷里朝我喊。

lines.en: scene yumialley1
I chase after it and wind up in front of something beautiful-
lines.zh: 我循声追去，最后停在某个美丽的东西面前——

lines.en: But only because I like the way its cracks look in the moonlight.
lines.zh: 但那只是因为我喜欢它的裂缝在月光下的样子。

lines.en: : I'm not really sure.
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定。

lines.en: : You're a fucking weirdo, dude.
lines.zh: : 你真是个怪胎，老兄。

lines.en: : Well, what about you? What are {i}you{/i} doing out here this late?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？这么晚了{i}你{/i}在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be back at the dorms or something?
lines.zh: : 你不是该回宿舍了吗？

lines.en: scene yumialley2
: Shouldn't you be minding your own fucking business?
lines.zh: : 你不是该管好你自己他妈的事吗？

lines.en: : Hey, you're the one who called out to me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，是你先叫住我的吧。

lines.en: : Did you get into a fight with Chika or something? Or are you just...being rebellious again?
lines.zh: : 你跟 Chika 吵架了还是怎么的？还是说你只是……又在叛逆了？

lines.en: : I did not {i}get into a fight with Chika.{/i} And I can promise you I'm not fucking...being rebellious or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我{i}没跟 Chika 吵架{/i}。而且我可以向你保证，我才没有他妈的……在叛逆什么的。

lines.en: : But it ain't like I expect you to fuckin' understand me either, so...ain't no point in talkin' about it.
lines.zh: : 不过我也没指望你能他妈理解我，所以……没什么好谈的。

lines.en: : Gotcha. Well, I doubt you’re looking to have a conversation or anything, so I guess I’ll just see you whenever you show up to school next.
lines.zh: : 明白了。嗯，我看你也不像想聊天的样子，那我就等你下次来学校时再见吧。

lines.en: scene yumialley3
: Hey...Wait up a sec.
lines.zh: : 喂……等一下。

lines.en: : You...
scene yumialley4
: You’ve been acting really fucking weird lately.
lines.zh: : 你最近真的他妈怪得要命。

lines.en: : Like...even weirder than usual.
lines.zh: : 就……比平常还怪。

lines.en: : I wasn’t aware that you were paying that much attention to me.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道你这么关注我呢。

lines.en: scene yumialley5
: Don’t flatter yourself, dickwad. I'm sure anybody with even half a brain has noticed by now. I'm probably just the only one with the balls to call you on it.
lines.zh: : 少自作多情了，蠢货。我敢说只要脑子还剩一半的人都注意到了。我大概只是唯一一个有胆子说出来的。

lines.en: : Just last month, you were on my case pretty much every fucking day.
lines.zh: : 就上个月，你几乎他妈天天找我麻烦。

lines.en: : Shit, dude. You even tracked me down at the arcade a few times and made it so I can't even chill {i}there{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: : 靠，老兄。你甚至还几次追到游戏厅来找我，搞得我现在连{i}那儿{/i}都待不下去了。

lines.en: : Doin' annoying shit has never really been {i}above your paygrade{/i} or whatever. I get that.
lines.zh: : 干些烦人的事，一向都没{i}超出你的「职权范围」{/i}什么的。这点我懂。

lines.en: : But now?
lines.zh: : 但现在呢？

lines.en: : Now it's like you're backin' down on even trying to change me with all this {i}Oh, just be less of an asshole{/i} shit.
lines.zh: : 现在你连试着改变我都放弃了，就只会说什么{i}「别那么混蛋」{/i}之类的屁话。

lines.en: : The fuck is going on?
lines.zh: : 到底他妈怎么回事？

lines.en: scene yumialley6
: It’s, like...messing with my head now and shit.
lines.zh: : 这……现在搞得我心里乱糟糟的。

lines.en: : I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢。

lines.en: : Just go back to givin’ me normal detentions or whatever if it’ll stop you from wanderin' around like a lost puppy in the middle of the fucking night.
lines.zh: : 你要是能别再大半夜像只迷路的小狗一样乱晃，就干脆照常给我留堂什么的吧。

lines.en: : Thanks, Yumi. But I think you might be misinterpreting something.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Yumi。不过我觉得你可能误会了什么。

lines.en: scene yumialley7
: Oh yeah? Like what?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？比如什么？

lines.en: : I’m not going through some depressive slump because of my inability to control you.
lines.zh: : 我可不是因为管不住你而陷入什么抑郁低谷。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m not really going through a slump at all.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我根本就没在低谷里。

lines.en: : I’m just...wondering what I’m doing here. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是……在想我在这儿到底在干什么。就这样。

lines.en: : What you’re doing here? This one of those, like...philosophical questions or some shit?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？这是那种……哲学问题还是什么的？

lines.en: : Maybe. It's kind of hard to explain.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。这有点难解释。

lines.en: scene yumialley4
: Yeah, then don’t bother.
lines.zh: : 那就算了，别费劲了。

lines.en: : We’re all doin’ the same thing anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正大家都在做一样的事。

lines.en: : Ain't nobody who just {i}gets{/i} what they're doing here. We're all just...trying to survive in our own ways and all that shit.
lines.zh: : 没有谁真的{i}明白{/i}自己在这儿干什么。我们都只是……用自己的方式努力活下去之类的。

lines.en: : Not gonna carry on with that thought, though, since all you'll hear is just some fucking...chance to get to know me or whatever.
lines.zh: : 不过这个话题我不打算继续了，因为你听到的只会是些他妈的……「了解我的机会」什么的。

lines.en: : Wow. It's almost like you can read my mind.
lines.zh: : 哇。你简直像会读心术一样。

lines.en: scene yumialley8
: The fuck is your deal, dude?! I’m finally being serious about something, so the least you can do is try to be serious as well!
lines.zh: : 你他妈怎么回事啊，老兄？！我好不容易认真一次，你至少也该试着认真点吧！

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m just...a little surprised.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是……有点意外。

lines.en: : You always act like you're on top of the world, so it's weird thinking you might actually be somewhat vulnerable.
lines.zh: : 你平时总是一副天下无敌的样子，所以想到你其实也可能有点脆弱，感觉挺奇怪的。

lines.en: scene yumialley4
: I ain't {i}vulnerable...{/i}And just because I'm showin' a slightly different side of myself doesn't mean I like you all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我才不{i}脆弱{/i}……而且我只是露出稍微不同的一面，不代表我就突然喜欢你了。

lines.en: : I still think you’re a fucking creep who spends way too much time around [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: : 我依然觉得你是个恶心变态，成天跟[teenage]女生混在一起的时间长得离谱。

lines.en: : But...I guess you probably have your reasons.
lines.zh: : 不过……我猜你大概也有你的理由。

lines.en: : I mean, being a [high_school] teacher is probably the only acceptable reason for something like that, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我是说，当个[high_school]老师大概是这种事唯一说得过去的理由吧？

lines.en: : I guess so. Still seems fucking weird, though. And not just in the gross, perverted way.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过还是他妈挺怪的。而且不只是那种恶心的变态方式。

lines.en: : It's like...the way you look at us is really...{i}off{/i} sometimes.
lines.zh: : 就好像……你看我们的眼神有时候真的很……{i}不对劲{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s almost kinda like you’re tryin' to remember something.
lines.zh: : 几乎有点像你在努力回想什么。

lines.en: : I don't know if there's anything more to it than just you wantin' to be young again or some shit, but...
lines.zh: : 我不知道这事除了你想再年轻一次之类的屁话之外还有没有别的，不过……

lines.en: scene yumialley3
: Whatever it is, stop doing it.
lines.zh: : 不管是什么，别再那样了。

lines.en: : And also, the next time you’re out here this late, don’t expect me to call out to you again. Got it?
lines.zh: : 还有，下次你再这么晚跑出来，别指望我还会叫住你。明白吗？

lines.en: : I just felt like bein’ nice today or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我今天只是想当个好人什么的。

lines.en: : You know, I’d appreciate it if you could do the same for your classmates every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 说真的，你要是偶尔也能这样对你的同学，我会很感激的。

lines.en: scene yumialley4
: Like I give a shit about them.
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不在乎她们。

lines.en: : Do you give a shit about {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你在乎{i}我{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene yumialley8r
: Wha- Fuck no, I don't!
lines.zh: : 什——他妈当然不！

lines.en: : I already told you I was just bein' nice today! Ain't anything more to it!
lines.zh: : 我都说了今天只是想当个好人！没有别的意思！

lines.en: : Can you maybe...feel like being nice around Futaba sometime soon? Because she's kind of terrified of you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 那你能不能……哪天也对 Futaba 好一点？因为她其实挺怕你的，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumialley8
: Fuck no. Futaba's gotta actually stand up for herself for once and stop lettin’ me walk all over her. She ain't earned the right to be {i}terrified{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 他妈不可能。Futaba 得真的为自己站出来一次，别再任由我骑在她头上。她还没资格{i}害怕{/i}呢。

lines.en: : Standing up for yourself is easier said than done, you know. Some people just...can't really do that.
lines.zh: : 为自己站出来说起来容易做起来难，你知道的。有些人就是……真的做不到。

lines.en: scene yumialley4
: Ain't ever been a problem for me...
lines.zh: : 对我来说从来不是问题……

lines.en: Yumi looks like she wants to say more, but cuts herself off and goes back to staring at the ground.
lines.zh: Yumi 看起来还想说些什么，却自己打住，又低头盯着地面。

lines.en: It’s strange how the first ‘normal’ conversation we’ve had is in an alleyway in the middle of the night-
lines.zh: 我们第一次「正常」的对话，居然发生在深夜的小巷里，这可真奇怪——

lines.en: But I guess expecting anything about our relationship to be normal wouldn't really make any sense.
lines.zh: 不过，指望我们之间的关系有任何「正常」可言，本来也说不通。

lines.en: : Listen, I think you should probably head back to the dorms.
lines.zh: : 听着，我觉得你该回宿舍了。

lines.en: : I know you can hold your own, but it’s already dark out and we have class in the morning.
lines.zh: : 我知道你能照顾好自己，可天已经黑了，而且我们早上还有课。

lines.en: : Who says I'm coming to class in the morning?
lines.zh: : 谁说我明天早上会来上课？

lines.en: : I do. Because you are.
lines.zh: : 我说的。因为你一定会来。

lines.en: : Now, start heading back or I will drag you there myself.
lines.zh: : 现在，马上往回走，不然我就亲自把你拖回去。

lines.en: scene yumialley7
: You lay one fucking finger on me and I swear to god I’ll chop your whole hand off.
lines.zh: : 你敢碰我一根手指，我发誓会把你整只手剁下来。

lines.en: : Then hurry up and get out of here before you are buried in legal fees and medical bills.
lines.zh: : 那就趁还没被诉讼费和医药费埋了，赶紧给我滚。

lines.en: scene yumialley9
: Ugh...whatever.
lines.zh: : 呃……随便吧。

lines.en: : But I ain't doing this just because you told me to, got it?
lines.zh: : 不过我可不是因为你说了我才做的，明白吗？

lines.en: : I'm just tired as shit and it's been a long fuckin' day.
lines.zh: : 我只是他妈累死了，今天这一天也够长的。

lines.en: : Right, right...
lines.zh: : 是是是……

lines.en: : I’ll see you in class tomorrow, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 明天课上见，Yumi。

lines.en: : Have a good night.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: : Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi？

lines.en: scene yumialley10
: Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : Just fuck off already, would you?
lines.zh: : 你他妈倒是快滚啊，行吗？

lines.en: scene black
Yumi leaves the alleyway and I begin to head back home as well.
lines.zh: Yumi 离开了小巷，我也开始往家走。

lines.en: It's strange that I ran into her out here so late, but...I'm kind of glad that I did.
lines.zh: 这么晚还能在外面碰见她是挺奇怪的，不过……我倒有点庆幸碰上了。

lines.en: Not because I was able to remind her once more of how easily some people are impacted by her words-
lines.zh: 不是因为我又一次提醒了她，有些人有多容易被她的话伤到——

lines.en: scene happy9
$ yumi_love += 1
But because she was able to prevent me from walking toward the light.
lines.zh: 而是因为她让我没有继续朝那道光走去。

lines.en: {s}Congratulations!{/s}
lines.zh: {s}恭喜！{/s}

lines.en: {s}You have unlocked a special event with {b}[[redacted]{/b}!{/i}
lines.zh: {s}你已解锁与 {b}[[redacted]{/b} 的特别事件！{/s}

lines.en: {s}There is something buried underneath your feet.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}你的脚下埋着什么东西。{/s}

lines.en: {s}探してみませんか？{/s}
lines.zh: {s}探してみませんか？{/s}

lines.en: {s}Yumi's affection has xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx!{/s}
lines.zh: {s}Yumi 的好感度已经 xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx！{/s}
